description: Execute a One action to perform actual operations on third-party platforms. CRITICAL: Only call this when the user's intent is to EXECUTE an action (e.g., 'read my last Gmail email', 'fetch 5 contacts from HubSpot', 'create a task in Asana'). DO NOT call this when the user wants to BUILD or CREATE code/forms/applications - in those cases, stop after find_one_actions and provide implementation guidance instead. REQUIRED WORKFLOW: Must call find_one_actions first, which returns the action's documentation. If uncertain about execution intent or parameters, ask for confirmation before proceeding.

actionId.description: The actionId of the action to run, as returned when the action was found (or from the connection's `access` list).

connectionKey.description: The connection key for the caller's connection (from list_one_integrations).

data.description: The request body. JSON by default; encoded as form data when isFormData or isFormUrlEncoded is set.

headers.description: Extra request headers to forward to the upstream platform.

pathVariables.description: Substitutions for {var} / {{var}} placeholders in the action path.

platform.description: The kebab-case platform of the connection (e.g. "gmail"), as list_one_integrations names it.

queryParams.description: Query-string parameters appended to the request.

name: execute_one_action

requestConfig.description: The request as sent, with the One secret redacted.

responseData.description: The platform's response body, whatever its status.

status.description: The platform's HTTP status. A 4xx or 5xx is the platform's answer: read `responseData` for its reason.

title: Execute One Action
